scope: Failed repetition automation, not a firmware failure. QEMU will be deliberately stopped to correct the identified observer errors.
diagnosis: Repeat arming retained the previous full-press tick, so the old release timer immediately released each new half-press.
New readiness QMP reads were not protected by the machine I/O lock and raced with the held-key watchdog.
